**Outcome**: Usage counters from WRL's metering system feed into Stripe metered billing, producing accurate invoices at period end. Tenants see their consumption versus included quota on a dashboard, with clear overage pricing tiers.

**Success criteria**:
- Usage records reported to Stripe for each meter (captures, storage, API calls) at least hourly
- Dashboard endpoint (or web UI panel) shows current-period consumption vs included quota per meter
- Overage pricing tiers defined and configured in Stripe (e.g., first 100 captures included, $0.05/capture after)
- Invoices generated automatically at billing period end with line items per meter
- Usage reporting is idempotent (duplicate reports don't double-count)
- Metering data reconcilable: internal counters match Stripe usage records within 1% tolerance
- Failed usage report submissions retried and logged to Coralogix

**Scope**:
- In: Usage record submission to Stripe API, consumption dashboard data endpoint, overage tier configuration, invoice line item verification, retry on submission failure, reconciliation logging
- Out: Real-time billing (near-real-time is fine), custom invoice templates, usage alerts/notifications (future enhancement), credit system

**Constraints**:
- Depends on R25 (metering infrastructure) for the usage counters that feed Stripe
- Depends on R29 (Stripe integration) for customer/subscription/meter setup
- Stripe usage records must include idempotency keys to prevent double-billing
- Usage reporting must not be in the capture request hot path; use async submission
